name: Hamanu, Sorcerer-King
tactics: Hamanu is reckless and bold in combat. Unable to resist the feel of shattering bone, he throws mighty punches in between hurling potent magical attacks. Hamanu prefers his human form but transforms into a fearsome draconic lion when seriously injured.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Staff Implement
items.description: Using a nonmagical implement confers no benefit. You can purchase a magical implement to gain an enhancement bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with your arcane powers. A staff implement can also function as a magic quarterstaff.

powers.name: Cerulean Shield
powers.trigger: An enemy adjacent to Hamanu targets Hamanu with a melee attack.

powers.name: Mental Bastion
powers.trigger: An enemy dazes or stuns Hamanu.

effect.description: Hamanu makes a saving throw against the triggering effect. On a save, the triggering enemy takes 15 psychic damage and the triggering effect ends, even if it would not normally end on a save.

powers.name: Lion of the Desert
powers.trigger: Hamanu is first bloodied or first drops to 0 hit points.

effect.description: Hamanu pushes the target 2 squares. Hamanu takes on the Lion of the Desert form until the end of the encounter or until that form drops to 0 hit points, at which point he returns to his normal form with the same hit points he had when he adopted the Lion of the Desert form.
